   Green Vernon Commission Agenda Report

Meeting Date:  June 19, 2024
From:  Daniel S. Wall, P.E., Director of Public Works
Department:  Public Works
Submitted by:  Cynthia Cano, Administrative Secretary

Subject
City of Vernon Adopt-A-Tree Program

Recommendation
No action required by the Commission. This is an update presentation only.

Background
In 2021, the Gateway Cities Council of Governments received a grant from the California
Resilience Challenge to “develop local-level urban tree canopy assessment along with
community engagement and prioritization component in four cities.” Vernon was one of the four
participating cities. The assessment/engagement study was conducted by the Tree People and
Loyola Marymount University Center for Urban Resilience. The final report, published in
September 2022, provides Vernon with a detailed plan to capture the health and environmental
benefits of a healthy tree canopy. Staff will provide a progress update and the 2024
implementation plan.

The City has been on a mission in recent years to grow its tree canopy. In 2022, 166 new trees
were planted, 280 were planted in 2023, and adding 500 more is the plan for 2024. We have an
ambitious goal to increase our canopy coverage from 2% (the lowest in LA County) to 15%. The
City seeks community support to fund the planting and maintenance of trees through the Adopt-
A-Tree program.

Fiscal Impact
There is no fiscal impact associated with this report.

None.
